text:
mina: Alex submitted notice. End date 2026-07-02 (end of internship). Need laptop return logistics (Lisbon), final stipend calc, and benefits checklist (intern health top-up). Sam: can you confirm last deliverables and any handoff sessions?

sam: Alex finishes the mobile infra ticket on 06-28 and will do a 45-min demo 06-30 11:00 WEST. Keep GitHub access until 48h after demo.

alex: I can drop laptop with Lisbon office partner or schedule courier. Prefer courier after demo. I'll leave a short notes doc in /team/mobile/offboard-alex.md.

mina: Checklist: 1) IT schedule pickup 2) Payroll final stipend + any prorated relocation stipend 3) Benefits: confirm intern top-up end date 4) Exit feedback form.

it: We can pickup 2026-07-03 10:00 WEST. We'll run `offboard --user alex --delay-github-48h` at 08:00 UTC 2026-07-03. Please confirm device value for customs.

sam: Company book value EUR 800.

payroll: Final stipend will be pro-rated to last day. Any relocation stipend owed?

sam: One-time relocation paid on start; no outstanding installments.

benefits: Intern health top-up ends on last day 2026-07-02. We will send an info email with COBRA/intl-equivalents if applicable.

mina: Alex: prefer written or 15-min call for exit?

alex: Written is fine.

it: Pickup scheduled. Offboard job queued.

payroll: Final payment scheduled for 2026-07-10 payroll run.

mina: Thanks everyone. Marking as monitoring until device received and final pay done.

alex: Thanks team! Appreciate the experience.
